payload.title: UI Controller v8: model review hardening
payload.context: Bruce asked if we need a third reviewer. I ran GPT, Claude, and Gemini independently on v7. Consolidated P1/P2 findings below.

fixes.path_traversal: route_id now strict [a-z0-9-_] allowlist. Verified PoC blocked.
fixes.factory_bypass: Coordinator.__init__ requires factory sentinel token. Direct construction raises TypeError.
fixes.reconcile_auth: reconcile() now requires valid lease token.
fixes.infinite_ttl: Non-finite TTL (inf, nan) and bool rejected.

payload.model_reviews: GPT: 1 P1 (factory bypass). Claude: 0 P1, 5 P2. Gemini: 5 P1 (traversal, auth gaps, bypasses). All P1s addressed in v8. Note: GPT-4o-mini's own output had 7/10 verifiably wrong findings — independent verification essential.
payload.not_yet: No live input. Awaiting your v8 review.
